question: Which single feature in the history is MOST important for confirming that a patient's recurrent skin swellings are urticarial wheals?

answers.text: Each individual lesion lasts less than 24 hours and resolves without leaving any mark

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Correct. The defining behaviour of a urticarial wheal is its transience — each individual lesion lasts less than 24 hours and resolves completely without bruising, pigmentation, or scarring. This is the single most important feature distinguishing urticaria from mimics such as urticarial vasculitis.

answers.text: The lesions are located predominantly on the trunk and limbs

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Distribution alone does not confirm urticaria. Wheals can appear anywhere on the body in any pattern. The diagnostic feature is the transient nature of individual lesions — each lasting less than 24 hours and resolving without a mark.

answers.text: The patient has a personal or family history of atopic disease

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: A history of atopy raises the probability of allergic conditions generally but does not define urticarial wheals. Many patients with urticaria have no atopic background. The key feature is that each individual wheal lasts less than 24 hours and leaves no mark.

answers.text: The swellings are bilateral and symmetrical in distribution

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Symmetry is not a defining characteristic of urticaria — wheals may appear anywhere in any pattern. The critical distinguishing feature is the transient nature of each individual lesion, resolving in under 24 hours without a trace.

overallFeedback.feedback: The single most important fact about urticaria is that each individual wheal lasts less than 24 hours and resolves completely without leaving any mark. This transience is what defines the condition and must be confirmed in the history.

Exactly right. Transience — each wheal lasting under 24 hours and resolving without a mark — is the cardinal feature that defines urticaria and separates it from mimics. Always confirm this in the history.
